## PSTACK / Vstack receipt

Optional for external contributors; maintainers complete it. See `.cursor/rules/pstack.mdc`.
Paste real commands and real output, not paraphrases.

- [ ] **Lane / orchestrator:** <!-- single lane, or orchestrator + which lanes and their files -->

- [ ] **Test counts before:** pass / fail / skipped / total = <!-- <pass> / <fail> / <skip> / <total> -->
- [ ] **Test counts after:** pass / fail / skipped / total = <!-- newly deleted or skipped tests: 0 -->
